meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关 bug 时,它会先做调试、比对源码判断该由哪个仓库负责,再生成一份英文 GitHub issue(仅 openai/codex 可提 PR),内含复现步骤、根因和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件等 bug,尤其是需要带源码证据的根因和复现步骤时触发。

say.text: 我遇到一个 LazyCodex 插件 bug,帮我建 issue
say.note: 先调查根因,再写英文 issue

say.text: 帮我给这个 Codex CLI 报错写复现步骤并提 issue
say.note: 会比对源码决定归属仓库

say.text: 先搜搜有没有相同的 issue,别重复提
say.note: 有匹配就追加证据评论

howto.what_en: When you report a LazyCodex or Codex bug, it debugs, compares both source trees to pick the owning repo, then files an English GitHub issue (or a PR only on openai/codex) with repro steps, root cause, and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI, especially when source-backed root cause and repro steps are needed.

say_en.text: I hit a LazyCodex plugin bug — file an issue for me.
say_en.note: Debugs first, then writes the issue

say_en.text: Write repro steps and an issue for this Codex CLI error.
Search for an existing issue before filing a new one.
